text: Hi everyone, I have a question about permanent residency process🙏🏼 I got my "last" visa extension a couple of months ago, and they told us to bring all the regular papers together with a request for a permanent residency next time (I don't want citizenship at the moment as my homecountry doesn't allow having double citizenship). How long does it take after filing this request until receiving a permanent residency? They also scheduled that meeting earlier - a few months before my current visa expires. We asked them why and if it's not too early - they said it's gonna be ok, but didn't explain it (Ramat Gan/Givatayim branch) 😅 I certainly don't mind taking care of it earlier - the sooner, the better - I'm just afraid that the clerk could have made a mistake...🙈
